module_title: Intermediate Grid - Density Concentration, Decadal Growth, and Rural-Urban Splits
introduction: This tier explores demographic patterns over time and space, including spatial density, population growth rates between 2001-2011, and child metrics. In UPPSC Prelims, you will often be asked to arrange districts in ascending or descending chronological order based on these metrics.

core_concepts.title: Population Density (People per Sq. Km)
core_concepts.description:
- **State Average:** UP's density is **829 people per sq. km** (vastly higher than India's average of 382).
- **Highest Density Districts:** **Ghaziabad (3971)** > Varanasi > Lucknow.
- **Lowest Density Districts:** **Lalitpur (242)** < Sonbhadra < Hamirpur.

core_concepts.title: Decadal Growth Rate (2001-2011)
core_concepts.description:
- **State Growth Rate:** **20.22%** (National average was 17.7%).
- **Highest Decadal Growth:** **Gautam Buddha Nagar** (25.4%) > Ghaziabad.
- **Lowest Decadal Growth:** **Kanpur Nagar** (9.9%) < Hamirpur.

core_concepts.title: Child Sex Ratio (0 to 6 Years)
core_concepts.description:
- **State Average:** **902** (Alarmingly, this dropped from 916 in the 2001 census, showing a severe decline).
- **Highest Child Sex Ratio:** **Balrampur** (950).
- **Lowest Child Sex Ratio:** **Baghpat** (841).

core_concepts.title: Rural vs. Urban Population Distribution
core_concepts.description:
- **Rural Domain:** A massive **77.7%** of UP's population lives in rural areas. Prayagraj has the highest total rural population, while Shravasti has the highest rural *percentage*.
- **Urban Domain:** Only **22.3%** of the state is urbanized. Ghaziabad records the highest urban footprint in both sheer numbers and percentage.

important_entities.name: Kanpur Nagar
important_entities.significance: Kanpur Nagar registered a growth rate of just 9.9% over the decade. This indicates a highly advanced stage of demographic transition and stabilization compared to peripheral expanding districts.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Overall Sex Ratio vs. Child Sex Ratio Clashing
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
Never swap the leaders of the two gender metrics:
- **Overall Sex Ratio (912):** Led by **Jaunpur**.
- **Child Sex Ratio (902):** Led by **Balrampur**.
Check the age criteria ('Child' or '0-6 years') in the question prompt before marking your bubble.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Density is High in G (Ghaziabad) and Low in L (Lalitpur).
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Connect **G**haziabad to maximum congestion and **L**alitpur (the isolated rocky plateau district surrounded by MP) to open space.

exam_strategy_tips: UPPSC frequently tests the exact decimal points for the Decadal Growth Rate (**20.22%**) and Density (**829**). Avoid memorizing loose round figures like '20%' or '830' as statement-based questions will deliberately carry close, deceptive variants.
